in_marathi.name: Kaushar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Having auspicious power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaushar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaushika' meaning 'having auspicious power'. The name 'Kaushar' is associated with the ancient sage 'Kaushik' and is considered a powerful and auspicious name in Hindu tradition.
